page.overview:
Who is Hoichael?

Michael and Hoichael are two troublemaker children in the backstreets of Water 7. They idolize Franky, and even dress like him and use his motto as their own: "Mm, super!!", and similarly idolize Paulie. However, their backstreet delinquency has earned them ire from at least Tilestone and Peepley Lulu. Before the timeskip, they were part of class 6-5 of the backstreet elementary school.

Michael has short spiky hair. He wears a red vest with a green pattern that looks like grass. He also wears a yellow shirt underneath that has his name and a white circle. The middle of the circle has red and white character .

Hoichael has short brown hair which seems to be growing only on the top spot of his head. He is missing teeth. He wears a blue vest with pink flowers pattern, and underneath he wears a brown shirt with his name. In the middle of the shirt is a white circle that surrounds a red circle with a white katakana character .

Since they idolize Franky, they tend to imitate him, going as far as using his motto.
